purpose: REAL total-cost estimate for ONE bounded Opus-5 response-identity forensic capture. Plugs into scripts/opus_capture_ticket.reserve_capture(costs=..., cap_usd=...). NOT a code change to that module; a reviewer-supplied cost envelope.
accounting_note: Each line has usd (string) + basis. A cost that cannot be determined is set to null == COST_UNKNOWN in opus_capture_ticket (fail-closed): it is NEVER silently treated as $0; the reviewer MUST supply a real figure before reserve succeeds.

input_per_million_usd.basis: No authoritative published us.anthropic.claude-opus-5 Bedrock on-demand input rate is retrievable in this environment (pricing page lists gated non-GA models and truncates before Opus rows). Reviewer must cite the real rate+source+date.

output_per_million_usd.basis: Same as above for output tokens.

line_items_formula.gateway_policy: AgentCore Gateway request + Cedar policy-engine evaluation cost for 1 inbound + 1 outbound signed call
line_items_formula.runtime_lifetime: AgentCore Runtime persistence/existence cost attributable to the capture window (per-second/existence, not per-call)
line_items_formula.storage: Restricted evidence + retained artifact storage for the capture receipt
line_items_formula.telemetry: OTel span/export cost for the single traced call

model_input.basis: 2000 input tokens * input_per_million_usd / 1e6; blocked on unknown rate above (unknown - NOT zero)

model_output.basis: 256 output tokens * output_per_million_usd / 1e6; blocked on unknown rate above (unknown - NOT zero)

gateway_policy.basis: AgentCore Gateway + Cedar ENFORCE evaluation, 1 call; per https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agentcore/pricing/ - reviewer must pin the actual per-request figure (unknown - NOT zero)

runtime_lifetime.basis: AgentCore Runtime existence/persistence during capture window; existence-priced not per-call - reviewer must pin actual (unknown - NOT zero)

storage.basis: Versioned private bucket for retained evidence/artifact; reviewer must pin actual bytes*rate (unknown - NOT zero)

telemetry.basis: OTel export for 1 span; reviewer must pin actual (unknown - NOT zero)

cap_usd.basis: Existing lifetime all-service USD5 self-cap (foundation_runs). cap_usd for THIS ticket must be set to the SUM of the real line items above once known, not 5 blindly.

worked_example_reference_only.disclaimer: REFERENCE ONLY - NOT authoritative for opus-5. Illustrates the token math with a real published Claude Opus-class Bedrock rate so the reviewer sees the shape; do NOT reserve with these numbers.

assumed_reference_rate.source: Anthropic Claude Opus-class published Bedrock on-demand tier (reference)

worked_example_reference_only.conclusion: Even with token rates known, total is NOT the token subtotal: 4 non-token services remain unknown-NOT-zero and must be priced before a real reservation.
